Valid active currency codes are registered with the ISO 4217 Maintenance Agency, consist of three (3) contiguous letters, and are not yet withdrawn on the day the me
What the XSD already checks: XSD pattern accepts any three capital letters
What is not checked: Needs the ISO 4217 active currency list

Text (MDR PDF): The Currency Code must be registered, or have already been registered. Valid active or historic currency codes are registered with the ISO 4217 Maintenance Agency, consist of three (3) contiguous letters, and may be or not be withdrawn on the day the message containing the Currency is exchanged.
What the XSD already checks: XSD pattern accepts any three capital letters
What is not checked: Needs the ISO 4217 active and historic list

Text (MDR PDF): Only a valid Business identifier code is allowed. Business identifier codes for financial or non- financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority in the ISO directory of BICs, and consists of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.
What the XSD already checks: XSD pattern checks the 8/11 character structure
What is not checked: BIC existence in the ISO 9362 registry is not checked
Manual action needed: Use real BICs when a realistic sample matters

Text (MDR PDF): Valid BICs for financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority in the ISO directory of BICs, and consist of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.
What the XSD already checks: XSD pattern checks the 8/11 character structure
What is not checked: BIC existence in the ISO 9362 registry is not checked
Manual action needed: Use real BICs when a realistic sample matters

Text (MDR PDF): The code is checked against the list of country names obtained from the United Nations (ISO 3166, Alpha-2 code).
What the XSD already checks: XSD pattern accepts any two capital letters

Text (MDR PDF): The number of fractional digits (or minor unit of currency) must comply with ISO 4217. Note: The decimal separator is a dot.
What the XSD already checks: XSD limits total and fraction digits generically
What is not checked: Needs fraction digits per currency (for example JPY 0, BHD 3)

Text (MDR PDF): A valid IBAN consists of all three of the following components: Country Code, check digits and BBAN.
What the XSD already checks: XSD pattern checks length and character classes
Manual action needed: Use IBANs with valid check digits (DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00 is valid)
